Four newborns die after birth in autorickshaw due to alleged ambulance delay

A woman in Madhya Pradesh delivered quadruplets inside an autorickshaw, but all four premature newborns died. The family claims that the deaths could have been prevented if an ambulance had been available on time. This incident highlights concerns about emergency medical services and accessibility in the region.
